summary: Apply AI to demand forecasting, supplier insights, and procurement workflows. Review risks and build a practical adoption roadmap. Explore the course.
lede: AI for procurement and supply chain decision support helps procurement leaders, planners, and supply chain teams assess AI use in operational workflows. The course covers preparing demand data, interpreting WAPE forecast errors, checking supplier insights and document extractions, and triaging exceptions. Participants also practise human validation and risk controls to evaluate where AI can support planning and procurement decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who assess, plan, execute, or govern AI-enabled procurement and supply chain workflows.
modules: SCOR and Supply Chain AI Use Cases
prerequisites: Working familiarity with procurement, demand planning, supplier management, or logistics workflows is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Bring a laptop with Excel access for spreadsheet-based exercises; Power BI is discussed for dashboard concepts and is not required.
